description: SEC Schedule 14A proxy filings: DEF 14A (annual meeting), DEFA14A (additional materials), DEFM14A (merger vote), DEFR14A (revised). One row per filing, metadata only (body: primary_document_url). From 2016, all US public companies, updated daily. ticker is the primary common ticker: use company_cik for every share class. period_of_report is blank on most rows: use filing_date for chronology. since/until: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, on the sort_by date. More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_proxy_filings

sort_by.description: Default filing_date. Blank period_of_report: last (asc: first).
